thread:
emma: Heads-up: sampleapp e2e flaky on CI. POST + coroutine cancel -> intermittent duplicate uploads (server sees 2 uploads). happens only under high latency.

juan: which stack? retrofit + okhttp versions? emulator or device?

emma: retrofit 2.9.0 coroutine adapter (kotlinx), okhttp 4.11.0, Android 13 emulator. test simulates network pause then resume.

li: sounds like a cancel race. coroutine cancellation cancels the Call, but our RetryInterceptor will still attempt another try if the original failed with IOException. if cancel happens after first bytes sent, server may accept then retry resends.

maya: so root is non-idempotent POST being retried. quick mitigation: for non-idempotent endpoints set retryOnConnectionFailure=false or tag requests to skip retry.

emma: can we tag at Retrofit level? i.e. annotate interface method or set header? patching every call is noisy.

li: we added a small Call.Factory wrapper before that can attach tags based on annotations. example: add @NoRetry on Retrofit interface method and adapter does request.newBuilder().tag(Boolean::class.java, true)

juan: pseudo-code for interceptor-check is like:

```kotlin
class RetryInterceptor: Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val req = chain.request()
    val noRetry = req.tag(Boolean::class.java) ?: false
    if (noRetry) return chain.proceed(req)
    // existing retry loop
  }
}
```

emma: nice. also worth noting: callTimeout covers retries; if you set per-call timeout with call.timeout() in OkHttp 4.11 you can tune it. but Retrofit-level timeouts are trickier.

maya: other option: make POST idempotent using an idempotency key header. server can dedupe. sample app could default to sending x-idempotency-key for uploads.

li: agreed. Idempotency key is best for real product flows. For tests we should avoid automatic retry.

juan: one more gotcha: OkHttp's dispatcher queue size can starve calls when many retries queued; for heavy upload tests drop retry attempts and rely on backoff on client side.

emma: plan: 1) add @NoRetry annotation + Call.Factory wrapper to set tag for sample app tests, 2) update RetryInterceptor to skip when tag==true, 3) add sampleapp docs explaining idempotency-key recommended for uploads, and 4) add integration test that cancels coroutine mid-send to assert single upload. I'll open a small PR.
